Vacancy in Radiotherapy
Friday, 18 February 2022
4978 Hits
Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram, Wardha, Maharashtra invites applications for the
post of Assistant Professor (one) in Radiotherapy
at Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences in the prescribed proforma. The department of Radiotherapy on an average treats around 1100 patients annually and is equipped with a linear accelerator with IGRT & IMRT capabilities (M/s Varian), telecobalt (Phoenix), high-dose-rate brachytherapy unit (M/s Elekta), hyperthermia unit and is in the process of acquiring a wide-bore CT-simulator shortly. Chemotherapy for all solid tumors is within the domain of activities of the department. The department runs a postgraduate training programme in radiotherapy (MD) and is actively involved in quality assured clinical radiation therapy, teaching, training and research in radiation oncology and medical physics.
Interested candidates are invited to enclose all certified photocopies of academic, list of publications and experience certificates which should reach to the office of the Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram, Dist. Wardha 442102, Maharashtra (email:
secretaryoffice@mgims.ac.in
) latest by
March 7, 2022
. The appointment would presently be on adhoc basis till the meeting of next Selection Committee of MUHS is held.
Click here to download the form
Qualification:
MBBS with MCI recognized post-graduate degree in Radiotherapy
Experience:
As per MCI / MUHS norms.
Pay scale:
As per rules of Kasturba Health Society
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
